C000.why: Substantive change: system or feature now leaves active mode instead of transitioning to stand-by, with an exception for driver unavailability response.

C001.why: Adds a new 2-second disengagement condition before a manoeuvre may be initiated.

C002.why: Mainly a cross-reference update after renumbering, though the referenced content may differ.

C003.why: The 7-second EOR restriction on initiating a manoeuvre is removed; likely flagged unless it was moved elsewhere.

C004.why: Only changes the examples in a manufacturer description duty in the safety concept, which is documentation.

C007.why: Narrows RMF compliance to the driver unavailability response; moderate substance.

C008.why: Rewording of the safe-stop requirement; minor change.

C012.why: Reverses the rule: dashboard may now count as a relevant area for up to 3 seconds while manoeuvre information is shown.

C014.why: The 200 ms minimum is unchanged; overlaps with C013.

C015.why: Adds gaze-direction change as an example assessment strategy; minor.

C022.why: New requirement not to initiate manoeuvres that violate signage or performance requirements.

C028.why: New functional obligation for non-highway operation.

C029.why: New obligation on how relevant situations are managed.

C030.why: New DCA obligation when approaching a system boundary.

C032.why: Permissive clause, but establishes a new capability.

C033.why: Restricting condition on the system's behaviour.

C039.why: New behavioural obligation for HOR withholding.

C043.why: Demonstration of safe operation with cyclists; a substantive capability.

C047.why: Documentation and assessment by the authority.

C049.why: Permissive clause; the source also contains a 'shall only resume' condition.

C050.why: New functional obligation about when HOR withholding resumes after the driver is deemed disengaged.

C051.why: New driver information obligation on the system.

C052.why: New driver state monitoring obligation to assess drowsiness.

C054.why: New functional restriction on system-initiated manoeuvres when the driver is not engaged.

C059.why: Permissive clause that alters the lane change behaviour obligation.

C061.why: Extends the 6.3 provisions to straight crossing at intersections, a substantive obligation.

C062.why: New functional condition for drive-off from standstill.
